ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:3 ratio of high-intensity (white/mottled) to low-intensity (dark/black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct contiguous high-intensity mottled regions are localized on the distal 30% of both left and right lobes. The central 40% of the fluke, encompassing the median notch region, consists of a contiguous low-intensity pixel block. High-frequency high-intensity point-source pixels are distributed globally across both low and high-intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated boundary along the trailing edge; pixel amplitude of individual peaks varies from 3 to 15 pixels relative to the local edge mean.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits an overall concave curvature transitioning from the distal tips toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct, high-contrast dark vertical linear disruption (approx. 40 pixels in length) is detected within the high-intensity mottled region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single prominent vertical linear mark on the right lobe; irregular deep indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe distal tip suggestive of mechanical trauma.
